annotations.title: Add or subtract days, hours and minutes from a date-time

description: Move a date and clock time forward or back by days, hours and minutes in a US time zone and get the resulting date and time. Days move the calendar date and keep the clock time (the way a phone calendar does); hours and minutes are counted as they really pass, so a daylight saving change inside the span is handled. Use time_duration_between instead to measure the gap between two known date-times, add_to_date for calendar years, months and weeks, and convert_time_zone to show a moment in other zones.

direction.description: add to move forward, subtract to move back. Default add.

start_date.description: The date to start from as a calendar date in the form YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-02.

start_time.description: The time to start from as a 24-hour clock time in the form HH:MM, for example 22:30.

time_zone.description: The time zone the clock times are read in, so a span across a daylight saving change counts the hour that really passes. Use 'none' for plain 24-hour days with no zone. Default America/New_York.

name: add_time_to_datetime

calculator_url.description: The TeamPredict calculator page that shows the same calculation, where a person can change the inputs.

inputs.description: The inputs as used, with defaults filled in.

results.description: The computed numbers. Unavailable numbers are null.

summary.description: One or two plain sentences with the headline numbers.
